project_type: Greenfield static web app (NecroText, a Teletext revival) with zero runtime dependencies, deployed to GitHub Pages
language: JavaScript (ES modules, JSDoc types), Node 22 for tooling
build_system: No bundler. npm registry is blocked (403) in the sandbox, so NO npm dependencies may be installed. Use only Node built-ins: node:test, node:assert, node:fs, global fetch. package.json has scripts only, type=module.
test_framework: node --test (node:test) in tests/. Property-based tests are hand-rolled with a seeded PRNG (tests/helpers/prop.js) because fast-check cannot be installed; document that fast-check is a drop-in upgrade.
build_command: npm run build (node scripts/build.js: assembles dist/ from public/ plus data/*.json, runs page generation to a prebuilt pages.json)
verification_instructions: npm run build && npm test; then node scripts/serve.js (tiny static server) and curl / to confirm 200
snapshot_or_generated_files: data/*.json are cached feed snapshots committed to the repo and refreshed by scripts/fetch-data.js (also run by a scheduled GitHub Action). dist/ is gitignored.
setup_instructions: None needed beyond Node >=20. No npm install.
environment_constraints: Sandbox blocks external hosts (feeds.bbci.co.uk, open-meteo, npm registry return 403). Cannot fetch live data or install packages. scripts/fetch-data.js must degrade gracefully and the committed data/ fallback snapshots must be hand-authored realistic samples. No docker. Sub-agents cannot push; commit on a branch.
contribution_requirements: Hackathon rules: public repo, MIT LICENSE at root, /.kiro committed and NOT in .gitignore with specs, steering, hooks; README run instructions; docs/HOW_KIRO_WAS_USED.md.
key_patterns: Pure functions render pages to a 40x24 grid of cells; renderer is separate from the DOM so it is testable in Node. Teletext control codes: colours, mosaic, double height, hold, etc. serial-attribute model like real teletext (a control code occupies a cell and displays as space).
directory_structure: public/ (index.html, css, js app), src/ (teletext core: grid, codes, mosaic, text-wrap, layout; pages/ generators; ghost), data/ (cached feeds), scripts/, tests/, docs/, .kiro/{specs,steering,hooks}, .github/workflows/
